items.message: High tides are expected to cause flooding overnight.  Flooding is expected from 02:00am to 04:30am on 24/10/2026.  Locations most affected will be coastal roads, footpaths and foreshore areas.  We are closely monitoring the situation .  Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   This message will be updated by 15:00hrs on Saturday 24 October or as the situation changes.
